1) How can we look up the job?
   - Do you have any of these:
     - Service ID
     - Confirmation code
     - The email or phone number used for the booking
     - Approximate service date and address

   - Briefly describe the issue (e.g., leak not fixed, damage caused, overcharged, no-show, late arrival, etc.).

   - Full refund, partial refund, or something else (e.g., redo the work)?

- Any ID/confirmation info you have
- The email/phone on the booking
- Rough service date and location
- A short description of the problem
